commits.message:
fix(text): a RichText ending in a newline keeps its trailing blank line through wrap, as Rich does (rich-text-vj2a)

RichText.render took its lines from Segment.splitLines, Rich's split_lines,
which drops a trailing empty line, and patched the break back in. Rich wraps
split(allow_blank=True), so that line is justified like any other. The
splitter is now handed the text closed by one more break, so every line the
text has comes back and the patch is gone.

fix(progress): TimeRemainingColumn estimates speed from the last 30 seconds of updates, as Rich does (rich-progress-jj5r.ef9) (#333)

* fix(progress): TimeRemainingColumn estimates speed from the last 30 seconds of updates, as Rich does (rich-progress-jj5r.ef9)

Progress keeps Rich's ProgressSample window per task and derives Task.speed
once a frame beside elapsed; timeRemaining reads it instead of
completed / elapsed over the task's whole life.

* fix(progress): samples kept in place, negative estimates drawn as Rich's floor divmod draws them, speed window documented from the latest update (rich-progress-jj5r.ef9)

effects-feel: breaths come in spells and rest after a sigh, wind gathers and slackens, halos never add (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Breath depth follows slow noise over the breaths, and the breath after a
sigh is quieter (x0.8) and late. Drift's advance surges between 0.33x and
1.15x STRIDE on noise over two periods. Overlapping firefly halos take
the brighter, as shimmer's passes do.

Worst 1 fps step over an hour: pulse 0.0395 (unchanged), drift
0.0286 -> 0.0256, sparkle 0.0324 -> 0.0236. A loose answering wave
between fireflies was tried and dropped: it bunched every turn's flashes
into one burst with long dark gaps.

effects-feel: a sigh catches once on the way in and draws in again (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

A swell is now a list of knots joined by raised cosines; breath and
firefly flash keep their shapes, and the sigh gains its double inhale.
Each part of the sigh's inhale climbs less steeply than a breath, so the
1 fps worst step over an hour stays 0.0395. REACH 0.3 -> 0.27 keeps a
whole-element rest between breaths now a sigh lasts 0.70 of its turn.
